name: Visualise Energy Map
description: Colour a surface by the sound pressure level of the scene's sources: the surface is meshed into faces no larger than spacing, one point per face centre, and each point gets the direct sound and the first-order image sources, and pyroomacoustics' rays past them, enough rays for every point to stay within about 0.5 dB from run to run (more in larger rooms), with each source's level at 1 m (Source spl). Blue is the lowest level, red the highest; a face outside the room or inside an obstacle is grey. The ray tracer over-estimates the late energy of surfaces that scatter strongly (up to about 3 dB at scattering 0.6 to 1). The Preview button shows or hides the drawing.

inputParameters.name: mesh
inputParameters.description: The analysis surface: a mesh, a surface or a Brep, for instance a plane at ear height. It is meshed into faces no larger than spacing, one point per face centre.

inputParameters.name: spacing
inputParameters.description: The largest edge of the map's faces, in metres: one point every spacing, 0.25 m unless given (Pachyderm's mapping uses 0.5 m). The rays are traced on a 1 m grid whatever the spacing, so a finer map costs little more.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of one source, in the order of the scene's sources. Empty (default): every source, their energies added.

inputParameters.name: frequency_bands
inputParameters.description: One octave band, 0 (125 Hz) to 6 (8 kHz). Empty: the full level of all bands, A-weighted.

inputParameters.name: range
inputParameters.description: The levels in dB the colours run between. Empty (default): the lowest and highest level on the mesh.

outputParameters.name: mesh
outputParameters.description: The mesh with each face in the colour of its level.

outputParameters.name: values
outputParameters.description: The level of each face in dB (dB(A) without a band); NaN outside the room.
